evaluation_design.baseline: position-group target-observed prevalence estimated from the outer fold training period
evaluation_design.hyperparameter_selection: expanding-year training-only validation using Brier score; default L2=1.0 when no inner validation fold is available
evaluation_design.preprocessing: training-fold median imputation, training-fold scaling, explicit missingness channel
evaluation_design.training_rule: for holdout year Y, train only on seasons < Y
